landing.title: MadHoney — Free Discord Anti-Spam Bot (Honeypot + Captcha Verification)
landing.metaDesc: MadHoney is a free anti-spam bot for Discord. It puts your channels behind a verified role. A spam bot posts in the honeypot channel and gets a ban. A human clicks Verify and gets access. Free dashboard and fast setup.
landing.heroSub: MadHoney does not try to identify spam. It configures your server so that only a spam bot can start the trap. A human clicks Verify, reads a captcha, and gets access. A spam bot posts in the honeypot channel. MadHoney bans the spam bot and removes its messages before you wake up.
landing.ctaAdd: ＋ Add to Discord. It is free
landing.whyH2: One spam bot. Unread markers everywhere.
landing.whyLead: A spam bot does not post one time. It posts in each channel that it can see, and it tries to ping @everyone. Each message makes an unread marker, and the markers usually stay after you remove the spam. Your server then shows "new messages" in each channel. MadHoney catches the spam bot in one channel before it can touch the rest of your server.
landing.step1P: Each channel is behind a verified role. A new account sees two things only: your rules channel and the honeypot channel.
landing.step2P: A human clicks Verify, reads an image captcha, and types the code. Then the full server opens. This takes about ten seconds. There are no DMs and no third-party websites.
landing.step3P: The honeypot channel has a usual name (#general-2). It is the only channel where an unverified account can post. A spam bot posts in each channel that it can, so it posts there first. MadHoney bans the spam bot immediately and removes its messages from the last 7 days. Verified humans do not see this channel.
landing.thinkH2: Spam bots are not smart. That is the plan.
landing.f1P: A spam bot does not select targets. It puts its message in each channel that it can see, and it pings @everyone if it can. Put all channels behind the verified role. Then the honeypot channel is the only open door.
landing.f2P: Give the honeypot channel a usual name (general-2, chat-2). To a spam bot, it is one more place to spam. The spam bot goes in.
landing.f3P: The honeypot channel contains one image only. A human reads "do not post here" and stops. A spam bot cannot read a picture, so it posts and starts the trap.
landing.f4P: The verified role hides the honeypot channel from each member who completed the captcha. Real members do not see the channel. Only a spam bot can post in it.
landing.showP: MadHoney makes the warning banner that stays in the honeypot channel. You set the headline, the text, the colors, the fonts, and your community logo. Design it with /madhoney banner or in the dashboard. The bot made the banner that you see here, live.
landing.feat1P: /madhoney setup shows you the role and channel pickers. Then /madhoney deploy gives access to current members, posts the panels, and gates your channels. A dry run shows each change before MadHoney makes it.
landing.feat2P: MadHoney reports each ban to a staff channel: who, when, and the message. If a curious human started the trap, click Unban one time.
landing.feat3P: Each honeypot catch, from each server, goes to one list. Opt in, and MadHoney bans known spammers when they join your server. You can also ban all of them at one time with Ban from List. Opt out at any time. Your catches then stay yours. Undo removes a user from the list on all servers.
landing.feat4P: The trap fires on where a message is, not on its text. There is no external database and there are no analytics. Staff and owners are always exempt.
landing.feat5P: Log in with Discord. Manage each server where you have Manage Server: configuration, verify message, banner designer, deploy actions, and the ban log.
landing.feat6P: Read it, fork it, or host it yourself. It is one Node process with three state files. github.com/nomadsgalaxy/MadHoney · OCL v1.1 + SWAtt.
landing.startLi1: Invite MadHoney and approve the permissions.
landing.startLi2: Make a Verified role and a honeypot channel, for example #general-2. Put the MadHoney role above the Verified role.
landing.startLi3: Run /madhoney setup. Select the role, your rules channel, the honeypot channel, and an optional staff log channel.
landing.startLi4: Run /madhoney deploy. Click each step: give access to current members → post the panels → gate the channels (dry run, then apply).
landing.startDash: or set it up from the dashboard
landing.warnOnboard: Do you use Discord Onboarding? Make sure that it does NOT give the verified role. If it does, the captcha does nothing.
landing.warnA11y: A note on accessibility. A honeypot is a visual trap. A member who uses a screen reader cannot always know that a channel is a honeypot channel. Do not use honeypot anti-spam on a server for members with low vision. If you use it there, write in your rules that a honeypot channel exists, and give its name. Then text-to-speech users also get the warning. You can always unban a human from the log channel.
landing.donateLead: MadHoney is free to add and free to use. There are no paywalls and no premium tiers. But servers and hosting cost real money. If MadHoney keeps your community clean, a donation helps pay these costs and keeps MadHoney free for everyone.
landing.footTagline:
Honeypot + captcha verification for Discord.
Made with 🧡 by Nomads Galaxy.
landing.costPower: Electricity for the server (the MadHoney part, at home rates)
landing.costFailover: Cloud standby (starts if the main server stops)
landing.costCloudflare: Cloudflare edge — Workers and the D1 database (free at this scale)
landing.costNote: MadHoney calculates this live from its real configuration — {watts} W of server use at {rate}/kWh. The maintainer donates the hosting. Ko-fi support pays these costs.
landing.costStory: I wanted to know how much my projects cost me. So I made a tool that calculates the cost live. I show the numbers here for full transparency. If you want to help pay this cost, you can donate on Ko-fi. MadHoney is always free.
landing.tourH2: All of it is a dashboard.
landing.tourLede: There are no configuration files and no hidden commands. Log in with Discord and select your server. Each decision that MadHoney makes is a thing that you can see and change.
landing.tour1P: Five steps. Each step has a button and a short text that tells you what the step does. MadHoney shows you what is complete and what is not. It warns you when a problem on your server can stop it.
landing.tour2P: MadHoney sorts each channel. Then you get the board. Drag each channel between gated, public, and leave-as-is. Nothing changes before you click Apply.
landing.tour3P: A thief with a member account sends the same message to each channel at one time. You set the number of channels and the number of seconds that count as an attack. You also set what MadHoney must do.
landing.tour4P: Design the warning banner in your honeypot channel: text, colors, font, logo, and distortion. Real members see a clear warning. A spam bot cannot read it and goes in.
